name: Pulse Lab: Tracker Face-Off
subtitle: Compare sleep, HRV & recovery
promotionalText: New: see exactly how your Watch readiness is built, put Watch and WHOOP head to head on five numbers, and open any stat for its full story.
description:
Pulse Lab puts your Apple Watch data and your WHOOP data side by side, so you can see where they agree, where they split, and which one to trust for each number.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
Watch readiness and WHOOP recovery side by side at the top, a morning briefing, and a plain-English Lab note about what stands out today.

HEAD TO HEAD
Resting heart rate, HRV, breathing rate, calories and steps, with Watch on the left and WHOOP on the right, each side showing its latest reading and when it's from. Tap a row for its chart.

READINESS, EXPLAINED
See exactly how your Watch readiness score is built: every contributor with today's value, your baseline, the difference and the points it added or took away, what's missing, a 30-day trend and how it lines up with WHOOP recovery.

EVERY STAT HAS A PAGE
Open any number for its full story: the latest value with its date and source, your normal range on a chart from 7 days to a year, low, average and high, the trend against last week, how closely the two trackers agree, why it matters and where the data comes from.

SLEEP, HEART AND MOVES
Sleep stages and duration, resting heart rate, HRV, breathing rate, blood oxygen, wrist temperature, steps, active calories and workouts. Every chart shows both trackers in their own colors.

THE VS LAB
Day-by-day agreement scores for resting heart rate, HRV, sleep, blood oxygen, breathing rate, temperature and calories, a running scoreboard, and Who to trust, which explains the better source for each metric from your own numbers.

YOUR SUPPLEMENT STACK AND INSIGHTS
List what you take, check it off each day, and Pulse Lab saves it to Apple Health as nutrients. Insights compare the next morning's recovery, HRV and sleep after days with and without a supplement, a sauna session, a workout, a late meal or alcohol.

EVERY NUMBER, IN ONE PLACE
All data lists every metric Pulse Lab syncs with a 7-day sparkline and its source. Data check shows exactly what is arriving from Apple Health and from WHOOP, so an empty chart is never a mystery.

LOG WHOOP BY HAND
No WHOOP connection? Type in the morning's recovery, sleep and strain in seconds, from a morning reminder or with Siri.

APPLE WATCH, WIDGETS AND SHARING
Today's numbers on your wrist and your Home Screen. Post the VS scoreboard as a clean card, or export everything as a CSV for your own spreadsheet.

FREE AND PRO
Today, Sleep, Heart, Moves, Stack and Insights, with both trackers side by side for 30 days, are free. Pulse Lab Pro adds the VS lab, Who to trust, 90-day and 1-year history, share cards and CSV export. Choose monthly or yearly (with a free first week for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics, no servers. Health data and WHOOP data go straight to your iPhone and stay there.

Pulse Lab needs the Apple Health data your watch records; WHOOP data needs a WHOOP membership. Pulse Lab is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by WHOOP. It is for general wellness and is not a medical device; readiness and the other scores are estimates, not medical advice.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in for Pulse Lab itself.

HealthKit: Pulse Lab reads heart, sleep, activity and workout data to compare trackers, and writes only the supplements a person checks off in the Stack tab (as dietary nutrients). On a device with no Health data the screens show empty states; launch on a phone paired with an Apple Watch for real data.

WHOOP is optional: Settings › Connect WHOOP uses WHOOP's own OAuth sign-in (a WHOOP membership is required). Without WHOOP, every screen still works with Health data, and Log WHOOP lets you enter numbers by hand.

Pro: auto-renewable monthly (com.troydunn.pulselab.pro.monthly) and yearly (com.troydunn.pulselab.pro.yearly) with a 1-week free trial as Apple's introductory offer, plus the one-time lifetime unlock (com.troydunn.pulselab.pro). Tap the VS tab, any lock icon, or Settings › Pulse Lab Pro to see the plans; Restore and Manage Subscription are on the same screen.
